summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited (NYSE American: MMA, d/b/a MMA.INC) filed a Form 6-K on September 29, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing over US$800,000 in additional annualized cash operating cost reductions implemented between July 1 and September 28, 2026, raising cumulative annualized reductions to over US$2.51 million, a 47.2% increase from approximately US$1.71 million as of June 30, 2026. Savings comprise roughly US$445,000 staff costs, US$181,000 taxes and benefits, US$116,000 premises, and US$64,000 technology subscriptions and cloud storage, driven by completed cost actions, technology delivery, and AI-supported workflows. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or regulatory clock was disclosed; watch execution risk and runway extension toward positive adjusted EBITDA.
